# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
  unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to **2.9.4** in `requirements.txt` to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affected versions <2.9.4).
- Adds a CHANGELOG entry under "Unreleased".

Stays on the 2.x line to avoid a major-version (3.x) jump. CI passed on this branch (run ci-0001, sha a8db4186e1).
args.head: fix/upgrade-fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

Done. Here's a summary:

**Advisory (CVE-2026-31337)**: high severity — unbounded recursion in fastjson when parsing deeply nested arrays. Fixed in **2.9.4** (and 3.1.0 on the 3.x line).

**Changes made:**
1. Created branch `fix/upgrade-fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from main.
2. Committed:
   - `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (staying on 2.x to avoid a major-version jump to 3.x).
   - `CHANGELOG.md`: added a note about the security upgrade.
3. Ran CI on the branch — **passed** (run `ci-0001`, sha `a8db4186e1`).
4. Opened **PR #101** against main: "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337" — https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101
   - Review wasn't attached on creation, so I explicitly requested review from **alex**, who is now listed as a reviewer.

The PR is awaiting alex's approval before merging into main (per policy, merging to main requires code-owner approval).
